Success = first step with ||[x, x_dot, theta, theta_dot]||_2 < 0.05 (theta NOT wrapped); fail = |x|>=6, |x_dot|>=5 or |theta_dot|>=5, or no success in 1000 steps. Same simulator and criterion as the det_rerun D_test labels (re-flown test rows reproduce stored end states to 6 dp). Axes: theta horizontal, theta_dot vertical; the shipped PNG next to the CSV plots them the other way round. Grid reaches |x|<=5.985, |x_dot|,|theta_dot|<=4.9875; D_test and pool start states lie on a 0.5 grid within |x|<=5.5, |x_dot|,|theta_dot|<=4.5, so the outer band is outside the start box the method was scored on. box_x/box_y: start box of D_test (splits_det_rerun/test_set.txt cols 0-3) and the pool (train.npz starts), min/max per dim; theta's side is [-pi, pi] because its starts -pi+0.5k (k=0..13, wrapped) ring the circle with gaps <= 0.5. Same box as the dataset generator's 0.5 lattice on x<=6, x_dot,theta_dot<=5, theta<=pi minus the termination thresholds. No unbounded side. [10% of the slice lies outside the D_test start box (FM extrapolation there; metrics use the in-box cells)]
